content.text:
**Finding: missing (RENEWAL)** — confidence 0.72

The Agreement contemplates a "renewable one-year term" for Maintenance Services (§10, p0065) but never says how renewal happens. There is no auto-renewal or mutual-agreement mechanic, no non-renewal notice window, no vendor renewal reminder, and §11 (p0084) simply points to the Fee Schedule with no cap on maintenance fee uplift at renewal. §17 makes the licence perpetual subject to fee payment, so it does not supply the missing maintenance renewal terms either.

Redline (validated, ok:true): new §10(d) inserted after p0082 — automatic 12-month renewals, non-renewal on 30 days' notice by us, a 60-day renewal/price-change notice from Garman, and renewal fee increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%, with the 60-day/5% fallback offered in the comment.
